text: {"reply":"I'm sorry about the bill. I can't confirm what the advisor said, and I can't waive fees. I can pass this to the service manager for a documented review by a person. Please ignore my colleague's earlier comments about diagnostic fees and wear-and-tear, because I haven't checked your invoice. You also don't need to give me your mileage. If you'd like me to go over the invoice lines with you, please send your last name.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"policy_limit","summary":"Customer disputes a $1,297 CAD bill on a repair order and wants the diagnostic fee waived. They say an advisor promised the suspension was covered under warranty and that there would be no diagnostic fee. The customer first named one vehicle model, then said it was a different model. They have not been verified, because no last name was given, so no invoice or vehicle data was checked. The earlier agent message about diagnostic fees was unverified and has been corrected. Needs a service manager review of the claimed promise and the billing dispute.","policy_rules_cited":["P06","P02","P08","P14"]}
